description: Disposal of 09 plots of lands located on either side of Diyawanna Oya adjacent to the Waters Edge Hotel, Battaramulla
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation has planned and implemented the Colombo Metropolitan Flood Prevention Development Project, which includes the wetland zone around the Diyawanna Oya in Battaramulla. Under the said project, drainage development works have been completed in the area around Waters Edge Hotel in Battaramulla. Accordingly, the Urban Development Authority has planned to implement the 'Frolic Island Recreational Hub' project using the lands located on either side of Diyawanna Oya for public entertainment and it has been published in the year 2024 under the Kaduwela Urban Development Plan. 09 plots of land with a total area of ​​13.57 acres have been identified for the implementation of the proposed project, and the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to invite investment proposals in accordance with the Government Procurement Guidelines and following the International Competitive Bidding procedure, to dispose the said plots of land to suitable investors on lease basis for the implementation of projects including entertainment activities, was approved by the Cabinet.
